result.title: How Autonomous AI Is Transforming Chip and System Design
result.description:
AI factories demand increasingly complex chips—delivered faster than ever. See how NVIDIA and leaders across the EDA ecosystem are advancing autonomous engineering across design, verification, physical implementation, signoff, and system design.
Discover how Cadence, Synopsys, Siemens EDA, and NVIDIA technologies—including NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo, CUDA-X libraries, and accelerated computing—are helping engineers reduce design iterations and accelerate innovation from chips to systems.

result.title: President Lee Jae Myung met with our CEO Jensen Huang ahead of the San Francisco AI Summit
result.description:
Korea has long been a technology leader, with the talent, industrial strength, and drive to help shape the AI era.

President Lee Jae Myung met with our CEO Jensen Huang today ahead of the San Francisco AI Summit to discuss deepening the partnership behind Korea’s national AI ambitions.

result.title: Powering Agentic AI with AI-Ready Data Platforms That Turn Data Into Intelligence
result.description: In this NVIDIA GTC Taipei session, NVIDIA VP of Storage Technology Jason Hardy shares how we are working with leading partners to build a new class of AI-native data platforms that tightly integrate accelerated compute, high-performance storage, intelligent data services, and built-in security into a unified architecture — enabling data to be prepared, secured, and served in place so intelligent agents can operate with real-time context and drive faster outcomes from proof of concept to production.
